title: Mushroom with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="38" y="55" width="24" height="35" rx="8" fill="#f5e6c8"/>
  <rect x="38" y="55" width="24" height="35" rx="8" fill="#e8d4a8" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <rect x="42" y="58" width="6" height="25" rx="3" fill="#faf0dc" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cap (dome shape) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="38" ry="30" fill="#e8453c"/>
  <!-- Cap lighter top portion -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="32" ry="22" fill="#f26b5e"/>
  <!-- Cap spots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="40" r="6" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="35" r="5" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="4.5" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="48" r="4" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="52" r="3" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <!-- Cap bottom rim (lighter shade for edge) -->
  <path d="M12 52 Q50 70 88 52" stroke="#f26b5e" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="63" r="4" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="63" r="4" fill="#2a1a3a"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="61.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="61.5" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 72 Q50 80 58 72" stroke="#2a1a3a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="70" r="3.5" fill="#f9a8a0" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="70" r="3.5" fill="#f9a8a0" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
